mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(A.INPT_DTM, 'hh:mi') AS time, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.FSR_STF_NO) || ' (' || A.WRTR_PLWK_DEPT_CD || ')' AS stfInfo FROM ODS.S_MRNNRNAD A WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.INPT_DTM::DATE = #{inptDtm} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY TO_CHAR(A.INPT_DTM, 'hh:mi')

SELECT TO_CHAR(A.INPT_DTM, 'hh:mi') AS time, CASE WHEN C.REC_CNTE IS NULL THEN B.NRST_NM ELSE B.NRST_NM || C.REC_CNTE END AS value FROM ODS.S_MRNNRNAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_CCVNVSBM B ON A.NRST_ID = B.NRST_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ZA.NDRC_ID, ' (' || ZC.NR_VOC_ABBR_NM || ' : ' || ZB.REC_CNTE || ')' AS REC_CNTE FROM ODS.S_MRNNRNAD ZA INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRNAE ZB ON ZA.NDRC_ID = ZB.NDRC_ID INNER JOIN ODS.S_CCVNVVBM ZC ON ZB.NR_VOC_ID = ZC.NR_VOC_ID AND ZA.INPT_DTM::DATE BETWEEN ZC.AVL_STR_DTM::DATE AND ZC.AVL_END_DTM::DATE WHERE ZA.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND ZA.INPT_DTM::DATE = #{inptDtm} AND ZA.LST_YN = 'Y' AND ZA.USE_YN = 'Y') C ON A.NDRC_ID = C.NDRC_ID WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.INPT_DTM::DATE = #{inptDtm} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY TO_CHAR(A.INPT_DTM, 'hh:mi'), A.NDRC_ID
